description: A utility module for versioned authentication password hashing and verification, supporting multiple algorithms (Argon2id, bcrypt, scrypt) with tenant-specific salts and global peppers. Includes functions for hashing, verifying, and ensuring tenant salts.

methods.name: getPepper
methods.description: Retrieves the global pepper value from environment variables.

methods.name: buildHashInput
methods.description: Constructs the input string for hashing based on password, version, tenant, and global pepper.

methods.name: hashPasswordV2
methods.description: Hashes a password using the preferred (v2) scheme, selecting the strongest available algorithm.

methods.name: hashPasswordV1
methods.description: Hashes a password using legacy static salt with scrypt, for verification of existing hashes.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verifies a password against stored hash, determining algorithm by hash format and version.

methods.name: compareHash
methods.description: Compares a constructed input with a stored hash using the appropriate algorithm.

methods.name: ensureTenantOrgSalt
methods.description: Ensures a tenant has an orgSalt, generating and saving one if missing.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: Hashes a password with specified version (defaults to v2).

methods.name: verifyAndMigrate
methods.description: Verifies password and provides migration to v2 hash if needed.
